description.text: Anesthesiology is a discipline in the field of medicine that studies how to relieve patients' surgical pain, ensure surgical safety, and regulate the physiological functions of the body. It is based on basic medicine (such as anatomy, physiology, and pharmacology) and clinical medicine (such as internal medicine and surgery), combined with anesthetic drugs, equipment, and techniques, covering the entire process from preoperative assessment, intraoperative anesthesia management to postoperative recovery. At the same time, it involves fields such as pain diagnosis and treatment and critical care emergency rescue. It is known as one of the "two pillars of surgical medicine" along with surgery. Its core objective is to create favorable conditions for surgery while ensuring the patient's life safety and to promote rapid postoperative recovery.

duration.text: The Anesthesiology at Xi'an Jiaotong University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.
